purpose: Post-enrichment holdout draft for retrieval regression. These queries were authored after the graph enrichment and are not used to tune the ranker or graph. Labels are provisional model-authored hypotheses, not expert-adjudicated ground truth.

independence.blindness: Not an independently administered blind study; keep sealed from tuning until an expert reviewer adjudicates relevance labels.

scoring_contract: Run through the production lexical ranker. Report per-case relevant hits and aggregate precision@10, recall@10, MRR and nDCG@10. Do not enforce a target score until labels are expert-adjudicated.
